title: Counterfactual replay — the same run repeated without the selected event
titleEs: Prueba contrafactual causal — Microescena con objetos y actores
description: Side-view model stage under a gantry: a pendulum starts a toppling chain of event tiles that reaches a vase (loss as described); the take rewinds, a claw lifts the selected event out of the model (dashed outline left in its slot) and the same take replays without it, following the SUPPLIED result (the loss still occurs, or it does not). Model as supplied; no legal test, causation or outcome is stated.

content.note: Visual illustration only. It does not state the law of any jurisdiction or decide validity, responsibility or outcomes.

license: Original vector artwork and code created for this project; no third-party assets.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

time.description: Optional relative time label, e.g. "T+2 min" (shown as supplied)

events.description: Events in the supplied order; the chain always follows this order (3–6) (array replaces the previous value)

from.description: Index (0-based) of the event where the link starts

kind.description: sequence (default) or causal; a causal arrow is only drawn when supplied here

status.description: proposed (put forward) or disputed (contested); the animation never resolves it

causalLinks.description: Per-link data. Link i joins event i to the next event; the link after the last event joins it to the loss. Links not listed are proposed sequence links. (array replaces the previous value)

link.description: Index of the link it is put forward against

alternatives.description: Alternative or intervening events put forward by someone; drawn as a barrier beside a link, never decided (array replaces the previous value)

label.description: Description of the loss (label hypothetical amounts as hypothetical)

losses.description: Loss as described. The first entry is the object that is struck; an optional second entry is a smaller object beside it. (array replaces the previous value)

selectedEvent.description: Event taken out of the model for the replay (0-based index into events). It is kept between 1 and n − 2, so the removed event always has a neighbour on each side

a.description: Caption for the trigger (the pendulum that starts every run)

b.description: Caption for the claw that takes the selected event out of the model

actorLabels.description: Captions for the two machine actors of the model

present.description: Tag on the selected event before it is removed

removed.description: Tag on the selected event once it is lifted out of the model

actionProgress.description: How far the concrete action is allowed to progress (1 = complete; lower values freeze it part-way)

target.description: Scene element the annotation points at

items.description: Editorial annotation shown during the hold

annotations.description: Editorial callouts shown in the final hold (array replaces the previous value)

finalState.description: SUPPLIED result of the replay without the selected event (the animation never infers it)

actorLabels.a: Trigger: starts each run the same way
actorLabels.b: Claw: takes the selected event out

objectLabels.chain: Model as supplied by Party A

annotations.text: Only this event is taken out; everything else stays as supplied
